scope.name: Awakening Legends high-gravity tranche
notes: Japanese Neo-era main expansion released November 23, 2000 with 57 modeled rows in the local catalog.
This pass deepens the release dossier plus ten high-gravity identity cards; the remaining 47 card rows stay generated follow-up work.

sources.title: Local Japanese classic catalog: Awakening Legends
TCGdex Japanese set endpoint: neo3 / Awakening Legends

claims.text: The local Japanese classic catalog models Awakening Legends / めざめる伝説 with a November 23, 2000 release date.
The local catalog and TCGdex-derived metadata model 57 card rows for Awakening Legends, with no source-gap rows in the local release file.
Awakening Legends is modeled as a Japanese main expansion in the ポケモンカード★neo series, using TCGdex set id neo3.

Awakening Legends matters because it gathers Johto's mythic pressure into one release: Ho-Oh, the roaming beasts, Celebi, and the Shining Magikarp/Gyarados reversal all sit in the same local set spine.

Collector attention naturally gathers around Ho-Oh, Entei, Suicune, Raikou, Celebi, and the Shining Magikarp/Shining Gyarados pair, while Crobat, Jumpluff, and Kingdra show Johto extending older evolution lines.
This source-set pass deepens the release and ten high-gravity card rows only; the other 47 Awakening Legends rows remain generated catalog-history follow-up work.
An Awakening Legends match should preserve Japanese title めざめる伝説, TCGdex set id neo3, local card number, and row id together; translated names alone are not enough.

special_identification_instructions.trigger: A listing, want, scan, or agent result says Awakening Legends, Japanese Neo 3, Neo Revelation Japanese, めざめる伝説, Shining Magikarp, Shining Gyarados, Ho-Oh, Celebi, or one of the legendary beasts.
special_identification_instructions.summary: Confirm Japanese Awakening Legends / neo3 identity by title, set id, card number, and row id before treating a card as this release.
steps: Confirm the Japanese release title めざめる伝説 and/or TCGdex set id neo3.
Confirm the card number/local id against the local row, especially for high-gravity names that appear in other products.
Do not treat English Neo Revelation, Premium File, later reprints, or same-character cards as equivalent without route evidence.
Preserve local source names and normalized collector names separately when the source text is messy or translated.
For transactional use, ask for front/back photos, number area, holo or secret-rarity features, and condition-focused surface/corner images.

narrative.why_it_matters: Awakening Legends is where Johto starts to feel ancient instead of merely new. Ho-Oh lifts the sky, the beasts move through the grass, Celebi bends the forest toward time, and the Shining Magikarp/Gyarados pair turns evolution into a secret. It is a release about memory changing state. For an agent, the important move is to keep the assembly visible: Japanese title, neo3 spine, card number, and row id before the famous names start pulling everything into generic want-language.

sources.title: Local Japanese classic catalog: Awakening Legends row: Crobat 006

claims.text: The local Japanese classic catalog identifies Crobat as Awakening Legends card 006 / local id neo3-006; the source row name appears as クロバット.
The local collector-texture signals mark Crobat as Holo Rare.
The current local Awakening Legends row does not provide an illustrator credit for Crobat.

Crobat matters because Johto turns an old Kanto nuisance into a final evolution with real collector presence. It is one of Awakening Legends' best examples of the set waking up older lines rather than only introducing new mascots.
For Crobat, preserve the Japanese set id neo3, card number 006, local id neo3-006, and Awakening Legends release route; do not rely on the translated or normalized name alone.

steps: Confirm the Japanese release is めざめる伝説 / Awakening Legends with TCGdex set id neo3.
Confirm the printed or cataloged card number/local id matches 006 / neo3-006.
Preserve the source-row name 'クロバット' and normalized collector name 'Crobat' separately.
Do not merge with English Neo Revelation, Premium File, later reprints, or same-character cards without route and number evidence.
For a trade, ask for full front/back photos, number area, holo/secret-rarity area when applicable, and condition-focused surface/corner images.
